name: 🥞 Pancake PB&J Stack
what: A batch of fluffy pancakes for the freezer, stacked with peanut butter and jelly on busy mornings.

core.name: Flour, sugar, baking powder
core.out: Bisquick or pancake mix, by the box

core.name: Eggs
core.out: pancake mix that only needs water

core.name: Peanut butter + grape spread
core.out: any nut butter or jam we have

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Melt the butter so it can cool.
Whisk 2 cups flour, 2 Tbsp sugar, 1 Tbsp baking powder, ½ tsp salt. In another bowl: 1½ cups milk, 2 eggs, the butter.
Stir wet into dry just until mixed. Lumps are good. Rest 5 minutes.
¼ cup per pancake on a buttered pan over medium. Flip when bubbles pop.
Cool, then freeze with parchment between. Weekday: warm 2, PB on one, jelly on the other, stack.

key: Stop stirring while the batter is lumpy. Over-mixing makes them tough.
done: Golden on both sides and springy in the middle.
plan_b: No time to cook? Toast with peanut butter, jelly and banana.
